breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet (u=0) and periodic. The ground truth removes the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly follows this by only including the Dirichlet condition: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions: u = 0 on all boundaries ∂((0,1) × (0,1))'. The incorrect 'periodic' instruction was successfully removed.
